notes: Choose how you're addressed (Mr./Madam President, Prime Minister, General, Supreme Leader, Your Highness, Emperor, Empress, Commander) on the start screen or in Settings. Interface colour themes in Settings: Holo Cyan, Radar Green, Amber, Violet, Steel. Leader calls: after you accept, raise your own asks (alliance, trade, aid, pact) on the same call; phone any leader yourself (📞 Call); denounce a country and its leader calls you angry or hurt, declare war and you get a threat. Voices carry emotion. iPhone: start-up can no longer hang on world data; lighter start-screen globe.
